shell.tagline: Soft-skill assessment through a structured interview.

loading.title: Opening your interview
loading.body: This takes a moment. Please keep this page open.

root.title: Access through your personal link
root.message: To take your interview, use the link sent to you by whoever invited you. This page cannot let you in directly.

unsupported.title: Unsupported Browser
unsupported.message: This application requires a supported desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, Opera or Safari). Please open it on a desktop computer.

consent.title: Privacy Notice and Consent
consent.body: To participate in the video interview, you must consent to audio/video recording and the processing of your personal data for evaluation purposes. The recording is used exclusively for competency analysis. You may withdraw consent at any time.

device_check.title: Device Check
device_check.camera_error: Camera not detected or not accessible. Please check your browser permissions.
device_check.mic_error: Microphone not detected or audio level is too low. Try speaking now.
device_check.continue_blocked: Enable your camera and microphone, then speak to continue
device_check.camera_instruction: Position yourself in the frame so we can check your camera.
device_check.mic_instruction: Say a few words so we can check your microphone.
device_check.mic_unavailable: We can't detect a microphone. Check that one is connected, then choose Retry.
device_check.recovery_instructions: Select the camera icon in your browser's address bar, allow camera and microphone for this page, then choose Retry.

live.listen_hint: Listen to the question, then answer out loud. Take your time.

call.duration_sr: {elapsed} elapsed out of a maximum of {total}

exit.label: Exit, you can resume later
exit.title: Leave the interview?
exit.body: The interview will be suspended and nothing is recorded. You can resume at the same question by reopening your invitation link in this browser, until {time}.
exit.body_no_deadline: The interview will be suspended and nothing is recorded. You can resume at the same question by reopening your invitation link in this browser.

suspended.title: Interview suspended
suspended.body: You suspended the interview. To resume, reopen your invitation link in this browser before {time}, or press Resume.
suspended.body_no_deadline: You suspended the interview. To resume, reopen your invitation link in this browser, or press Resume.

paused.title: Interview Paused
paused.body: The interview is on hold and nothing is being recorded. Resuming reconnects you to the same question, right where you left it.
paused.tab_hidden_warning: The interview was paused because this tab stayed in the background for more than a minute.
paused.network_failed: The connection could not be restored. Press "Resume" to try again.

done.title: Interview Completed
done.body: Thank you for participating. Your evaluation is being processed and you will receive the results shortly.

error.title: An error occurred
error.body: The interview was interrupted by a technical problem. You can try again now. If the problem persists, your assessment will need to be re-opened by the recruitment team.

403.title: Session Not Authorized
403.body: The interview session has expired or is no longer available. If you believe this is an error, please contact the recruitment team.

absent_phrase.title: Service Temporarily Unavailable
absent_phrase.body: A technical issue occurred with the interview service. Please contact support for assistance.

session_expired.title: Your Session Has Expired
session_expired.body: Your interview session is no longer active and cannot be resumed from this device. There is no self-service way to continue from here — please get in touch with whoever invited you to this interview.

spent_link.title: This Invitation Has Already Been Used
spent_link.body: This invitation has already been used and cannot be used again. If you have not yet completed your interview, please contact whoever invited you.

link_used.title: This Link Has Already Been Used
link_used.body: This interview link has already been used or has been replaced by a newer one. Please ask the sender for a new link.

link_invalid.title: This Link Is No Longer Valid
link_invalid.body: This interview link is not valid or is no longer active. Please ask whoever sent it to you for a new link.

link_reopen.title: Please open the link again
link_reopen.body: This page was reloaded, so your interview link is no longer here. Open the link again (scan the QR code or use the message you received) to start.

unsupported.title: Unsupported Browser
unsupported.body: This interview requires a supported desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, Opera or Safari) on a desktop computer.

unavailable.title: Service Temporarily Unavailable
unavailable.body: We could not reach the interview service right now. This is usually temporary — please try again in a few moments.

malformed_response.title: Unexpected Response from the Interview Service
malformed_response.body: The interview service returned something we could not read, so the session cannot continue. This is a problem on our side, not with anything you did. Please contact support.

generic.title: The Interview Cannot Continue
generic.body: The session ended for a technical reason and cannot be resumed from here. Please contact support.

busy.title: Many people are starting right now
busy.body: The interview service is busy at the moment. Nothing is wrong with your link: wait a few seconds and try again.

failed.title: We could not start your interview
failed.body: Something went wrong on the way to the interview service. This is usually temporary, so try again in a few moments.

identity.title: Before you start
identity.intro: Enter your name and email so your interview can be identified.
identity.privacy: Your name and email are shared with the organization running this interview so your interview can be identified and requests about your data can be handled.

errors.nameTooLong: Your name can be at most 255 characters.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name{'@'}example.com.
errors.emailTooLong: Your email can be at most 255 characters.
errors.emailTaken: This email address has already been used for this interview. Please contact the person who shared the link with you.

steps.0: A virtual interviewer asks you one question at a time, out loud. There is nothing to type.
steps.1: Answer by speaking, and take your time. Concrete episodes you actually lived through count for more than general answers.
steps.2: Your camera and microphone stay on throughout. They are what records your answer.
steps.3: You can pause between questions, but you cannot go back to an answer you have already given.
steps.4: There is nothing to do at the end: the result is sent automatically to whoever invited you.

scheduled_pause.title: Break
scheduled_pause.body: Take a moment. Resume the interview whenever you are ready.

generic.title: Stay focused on the interview
generic.description: Keep your face in the frame and your eyes on the screen.

tab_hidden.title: Stay on this tab
tab_hidden.description: Keep the interview tab open until you finish.

focus_lost.title: Stay in this window
focus_lost.description: Keep this window in front while you answer.

second_monitor.title: Use one screen
second_monitor.description: If you can, disconnect any extra screen and use only this one.

face_absent.title: Stay in the frame
face_absent.description: Keep your face visible to the camera.

looking_away.title: Look at the screen
looking_away.description: Keep your eyes on the screen while you answer.

looking_down.title: Look up at the screen
looking_down.description: Keep your head up and your eyes on the screen.

too_far.title: Move a little closer
too_far.description: Sit closer so the camera can see your face clearly.

multiple_faces.title: Only you in the frame
multiple_faces.description: Make sure the camera sees only your face.

fullscreen_exit.title: Back to full screen
fullscreen_exit.description: If you can, return to full screen for the rest of the interview.

clipboard_copy.title: Answer in your own words
clipboard_copy.description: There is no need to copy text during the interview.

clipboard_paste.title: Answer in your own words
clipboard_paste.description: Speak your answer aloud; there is no need to paste text.

second_voice.title: Keep the room quiet
second_voice.description: Make sure only your voice can be heard while you answer.

phone_detected.title: Put your phone away
phone_detected.description: Keep your phone out of reach until the interview ends.

analytics_consent.title: Help us improve this service?
analytics_consent.description: We would like to use analytics cookies to understand how the site is used. We do not collect your interview answers or anything that identifies you. You can refuse with no consequences.
